tbl_description: One row per analysed hour of a sonobuoy recording: cruise, sonobuoy, station, date/hour, recording quality, background noise, and 0/1 flags for eight blue/fin/humpback call types. Published as core `sample` (sample_type `scan`, child of its `deployment`), `obs` (acoustic_presence per species) and `obs_attribute` (call types heard).
One row per sonobuoy deployment (cruise label x sonobuoy number), derived from the scans: station, type (DIFAR/OMNI), first scanned hour. Published as core `sample` rows (sample_type `deployment`).
